## Summary

<!-- What does this change, and why? -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Title is a scoped Conventional Commit (e.g. `core: …`), imperative, ≤ 72 chars
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`; the DCO trailer matches the author)
- [ ] No AI attribution anywhere (trailers, message bodies, identities)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Conformance suite untouched — or intentionally updated, called out in the summary
- [ ] `reconverge-baseline.json` untouched — or every new entry states a reason that stands on its own
